info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Reward Points Account Retrieval API
info.description: The Reward Points Account Retrieval API allows users to access detailed information regarding their reward points accounts. This API provides essential data such as points balance, transaction history, and account status, enabling users to effectively manage their loyalty points. Typical consumers include banking and finance applications that aim to enhance customer engagement through reward tracking and redemption. With this API, businesses can integrate reward points functionalities seamlessly into their services, improving the overall user experience and fostering customer loyalty.

get.description: This endpoint retrieves the details of a specific Reward Points Account using the provided account identifier. It allows users to access their account information, including points balance and transaction history.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve the reward points account details for the specified account ID. Please ensure the request body is formatted correctly to receive the appropriate response.

200.description: Successful retrieval of the reward points account data.

GetRewardPointsAccountByIdRequest.description: A string representing the request body for managing reward points accounts.
